## What this changes, and why

## Done means

- [ ] Tests that assert exact values, seen failing without the change
- [ ] Docs true again: the `.md` edited and rendered with `npm run docs`
- [ ] The gate green: `npm run check` (or, without a Mac's GPU, what CI runs, and say so)
- [ ] No key, credential or personal data in the change
- [ ] I have signed the contributor licence agreement (CONTRIBUTING.md).
